title: Spaceballs - State of the Art - Amiga Demo (HD 50fps)
summary: A recapture in 50fps HD of Spaceballs' 'State of the Art', an Amiga demo released at The Party 1992. It showcases the Amiga's real-time animation, graphics and music in a few minutes.
why: HN uses it as the canonical example of what the demoscene could squeeze out of an Amiga 500 and a single floppy disk.

quote.text: That whole thing fits on 880 kB floppy and it's rendered realtime.
